# Ramon Medeiros

> Backend engineer in Stockholm working on agentic AI platforms, LLM evaluation, payments systems, and cloud infrastructure.

Ramon Medeiros is a backend engineer based in Stockholm who writes about practical engineering problems at ramonmedeiros.dev. His work spans agentic AI platforms and LLM evaluation, payment systems serving European markets, distributed backends, and the cloud infrastructure underneath them. He started out in virtualization and open-source systems tooling, then moved through test automation and continuous integration, into cloud infrastructure, and on to product backends.

## Expertise

- Agentic AI and evals: backends for agentic platforms, durable execution with Temporal, evaluation harnesses for LLM behavior
- Payments and financial systems: payment methods across European markets, Apple Pay and Google Pay backend integrations, subscription products, in-house ledgers, A/B pricing and fraud analytics
- Distributed backends: monolith-to-microservices migrations, GraphQL and REST APIs, third-party integrations, accounting automation
- Backend development: Golang, Python, JavaScript
- Container orchestration and IaC: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm
- Cloud platforms: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SSM, S3), Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Storage, CloudSQL, Bigtable, Identity-Aware Proxy)
- Message streaming: Apache Kafka
- Automated testing: Selenium, Robot Framework, Python unittest and mocking, API mocking with AWS API Gateway, end-to-end and UI automation
- CI/CD: Azure DevOps, Jenkins

## Education

- Universidade Estadual de Campinas (UNICAMP): Bachelor's Degree, Economics (2016-2018)
- Fatec Americana "Ministro Ralph Biasi": Technologist, Information Security (2010-2012)

## Languages

- Portuguese (native)
- English (bilingual)

- Swedish (elementary)

## Side Projects

- [Cheap Stocks](https://cheapstocks.app): a stock screening tool that helps value investors identify undervalued stocks

- [Send files over local network with Python](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2019/07/18/send-files-in-your-network-with-python.html): Python's built-in HTTP server for file sharing
- [Temporary email in tests](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2019/07/18/use-temp-email-tests.html): using temp-mail.org and Robot Framework for email verification in tests
- [Robot Framework on Safari and Azure DevOps](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2019/07/26/robot-safari-azure.html): running cross-browser UI tests on Safari via Azure pipelines
- [Set up a Kafka test environment](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2019/08/07/set-up-kafka-testing-env.html): running Kafka and Zookeeper locally with Docker for development

- [Keep YouTube video visible while browsing](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2019/11/12/keep-youtube-videos-visible.html): browser Picture-in-Picture via JavaScript console
- [Python pdb for interactive script execution](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2020/02/06/resume-feature-pdb.html): pausing and resuming long-running Python scripts with the debugger
- [Google Identity-Aware Proxy for external hosts](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2020/04/01/google-iap-external-hosts.html): protecting non-GCP applications with Google IAP using an nginx ambassador container on Kubernetes

- [Mock global Python modules](https://ramonmedeiros.dev/2020/09/07/mock-modules.html): patching top-level imports like boto3 in Python unit tests
